text: Find a missing space on disk: search by its id, or enter the new path by hand
description:
Felix 2026-11-24. Only spaces with a local path can go missing this way: checkouts (registry kind 'checkout') and the machine-local localPath of linked repos (.bowman/runtime). Created and remote spaces live in the server's spaces dir; if one vanishes that is a server bug, not something to search for.
- Detection: a checkout whose path no longer holds .bowman/meta.json shows as missing on the Spaces page (and in list_linked_repos as not-checked-out).
- Search: scan the home folder for .bowman/meta.json (skip node_modules, .git, caches) whose repoId matches; re-point the registry entry to the hit. Name matches are only offered as suggestions, never re-pointed automatically.
- Manual: a field to enter the new path directly; it is accepted when that folder's .bowman has the same id (or after confirming when it doesn't).
- Agents: an MCP tool doing the same (search, or take a path).
Build after the internal graph→space rename, with the new names.

status.comment: Local case (this machine, no accounts) and agents done. Backend: project.discoverLocalProjects reads each space's meta.json (name, repoId) and takes repoId/name filters (matchedBy 'id' = the same space, 'name' = only a suggestion), maxDepth up to 8, limit. Frontend: history entries remember repoId and name once a space has loaded; the Spaces page checks the recent paths on opening, a missing (or failed) one is red and gets a Find button (magnifier). MovedSpaceFinder searches nearby + home 6 levels deep: one id match moves the history entry there and opens it; otherwise it lists the matches (same space / same name) and has a field for the new path; a space there with another id is used only after 'Use it anyway'. MCP: find_spaces_on_disk (local-only), which also points to register_linked_repo targetPath for a moved linked repo. Not done: server checkouts on a server with accounts (follow-up idea). Entries in the history from before this change have no id yet, so for them the search goes by folder name (suggestions) until they are opened once. Evidence: backend test 'finds a moved space by its id; a folder of the same name is only a suggestion', ProjectSelectionView.spec 2 new cases (found by id → relocated + opened; typed path with another space asks first), project-helpers.spec relocation case, MCP test find_spaces_on_disk; pnpm check 25/25.
